column1: # Places (chapter 07): the manifest every scope of proximeet-places-review runs and is judged by.
# scripts/places_review.sh builds each run's -only-testing list from this file, in this order on its
# device, and scripts/places_review_results.py checks every row against the build's logs.
# Columns (tab-separated): scope, order, device, run, bundle, seconds, test, kind.
#   scope    places = the new Places review; signal = the 16 Signal executions of build 6ab7e942
#            Continue preview now opens Places instead of "End of this preview."; regressions = the
#            (build 6ab81e22), unchanged, with its time-gated repeat. Together: 41 unique test methods and
#            43 required executions carried over, and 11 unique Places methods in 13 executions.
#            After the Places correction these 56 required executions run again in three builds on one
#            frozen commit, in this order: correction, sweep, regressions (its rows unchanged); in
#            docs/verification/places-recovery-coverage.tsv they are recovery builds 2, 3 and 4. Build 1,
#            the first correction build (Codemagic 6ab8adb4, on 907d7401), passed 14 of its 15 required
#            rows; C12 failed on a product issue, so the product change and the correction run again on
#            the new commit, and nothing of build 1 counts toward the recovery. The places and signal
#            rows stay as the record of what was reviewed and can still be run as scopes of their own.
#            correction = the recovery's correction gate, the targeted Places correction after build
#            6ab8639c (the adaptive footer, one-stage back gestures, where a stage starts), reworked after
#            build 6ab88011. On main: C3, the case that build left interrupted, first and alone, in a run
#            whose bound includes the main runner's measured first start (about 300 s); then C1 and C2;
#            then the five Signal and interaction tests whose endpoint changed, with C9, in XCTest's
#            class order. On the smaller iPhone: the recorded correction walkthrough C10 (full holds),
#            then C12-C15, then C11 alone. 15 rows, all required. The scroll diagnostic's rows C16 and
#            C17 (kind diagnostic, runs probe_main and probe_small) are removed: build 6ab8adb4 collected
#            their evidence, and PlacesCorrectionTests/testScrollDiagnosticProbe stays in the test file,
#            sweep = the recovery's sweep, one build for what sweep_places and sweep_signal (both
#            removed) split between two: on main, the recorded journey P1 first and alone (run journey,
#            full holds), then P2-P6 (places_main), then S3-S6, S8-S10, S12 and S13 (signal_main); on the
#            smaller iPhone P9-P13 (places_small), then S15 and S16 (signal_small). 22 rows, all required.
#            It keeps the places and signal row IDs and test methods, so the builds reconcile by row ID
#            and device. Its recording is delivered unedited, like the correction's.
#            P7 = C9, P8 = C15, S1 = C4, S2 = C5, S7 = C6, S11 = C7 and S14 = C8: those earlier
#            executions are executed by the correction scope, on the same device, at the same commit,
#            by the same method in the same kind of run (short holds). docs/verification/
#            places-recovery-coverage.tsv lists every execution of the three builds and the earlier row
#            each covers; scripts/places_recovery_reconcile.py joins the three builds' results by it.
#   device   main = the selected iPhone 17 Pro Max; b = device B, its clone (same model and runtime);
#            small = a smaller installed iPhone. A scope uses main and one other device, and the two
#            run in parallel: regressions uses main and b, every other scope main and small. Every test
#            with 440-point pixel anchors runs on main (or b, the same model). The signal scope's
#            former device-B tests run on main, which is the same model and runtime.
#   run      one bounded xcodebuild test-without-building; within a run XCTest orders the tests by
#            class, then by name. A run named "journey" is recorded and alone, with full holds (places
#            and sweep: the full journey; correction: C10); every other run uses short holds.
#   seconds  the run's natural time bound; the build's deadline can shorten it.
#   kind     required = must execute once and pass; repeat = a planned second execution of a
#            required test from a fresh app and test runner, run only if the time budget allows both
#            it and the run after it; it is not a unique test and not a retry, and if it runs it must pass;
#            extra = a run that starts only when its bound plus 60 s is left before the deadline; if it
#            runs it must pass, and it is listed as not run otherwise; diagnostic = like extra in when it
#            starts, but its outcome is reported and never counts toward a verdict (no row uses it since
#            the scroll probe's rows C16 and C17 were removed).
# Automatic retries are off in every scope. A failed, skipped, interrupted or missing required
